name: jsreact
description: A collection of JavaScript utilities and tools for web development

scripts.build:assets: cp -r src/images src/robots.txt src/sitemap.xml src/_headers src/_redirects dist/
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run create-dirs && npm run build:js && npm run build:css && npm run build:html && npm run build:assets
scripts.dev: npm run clean && npm run create-dirs && (npm run dev:js & npm run dev:css & npm run dev:serve)
